Return only one JSON object. Do not add Markdown or explanations.

{"type":"search","query":"your search query"}
{"type":"finish","answer":"your concise answer","evidence_ids":[]}

For finish, provide the answer and actual document IDs supporting
the complete evidence chain. Use [] if no evidence supports the answer.
Never output placeholder IDs.

If the controller reports an error, correct the next JSON action.

results.title: White Airways
results.text: White Airways is a Portuguese charter airline headquartered in Porto Salvo, Oeiras. It mainly operates charter flights from Lisbon Humberto Delgado Airport on behalf of tour operators as well as on lease on behalf of other airlines.

results.title: IBC Airways
results.text: IBC Airways is an FAR Part 135 on-demand airline headquartered in unincorporated Broward County, Florida, near Fort Lauderdale. IBC Airways operates on-demand cargo services to the Caribbean. Its main bases are Miami International Airport (MIA) and Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL). In 2005, IBC Airways began offering on-demand passenger services.
